primary_supply_criteria.definition: Reduction in zero-proposal components on the frozen VAL split under the unchanged Stage-4D proposal policy.
primary_supply_criteria.role: NECESSARY (must be met to claim supply improvement); NOT sufficient alone.

minimum_meaningful_improvement.interpretation: H3 must close at least 30% of the [Tg, 1.0] Tiny-recall gap left by the frozen PREDICTED system.

AND: contamination observational: fp_components_per_image reported but NOT required to improve
success_definition.consequence_if_met: H3 proposal-supply redesign is PROSPECTIVELY SUCCESSFUL on the supply axis. Eligible for downstream promotion; Phase-15 reopen condition may be re-evaluated under separate authorization.

failure_boundary.label: H3_SUPPLY_REDESIGN_INSUFFICIENT
failure_boundary.consequence_if_fired: Target-support redesign declared insufficient for the supply axis. H3 is NOT closed. Phase-15 remains NOT_STARTED_AND_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Reconsider Option B (positive-objective reweighting) or Option C (recall-oriented output head) under fresh supervisor authorization. DO NOT promote this H3 checkpoint to the downstream Stage-4D pipeline or to Phase-15.

intermediate_zone.condition: primary supply improved but R_H3 in [0.15, 0.30)
intermediate_zone.handling: Report as PARTIAL; NOT a success, NOT the failure boundary. Require supervisor adjudication before any promotion; do not auto-close H3.

contamination_policy.rationale: C-only did not move Tiny Recall (R_C=0.0); contamination is not the recall bottleneck.
